description: Phase 6 prototype - development_recommendations.json. THE atomic knowledge unit, developer-centric: one record = one developer formulation's whole chart (id = dev_{formulation body}). Nested scopes[] (one of filmIds / filmGroupIds / processType per entry, most-specific wins) each carry their own conditions[]. Each condition row carries its own sourceId (box-speed from manufacturer, push from community). Rows are INDEPENDENT combinations: exposureIndex + temperatureC + timeSeconds + agitationProfileId (agitation may differ per row). DF96 is one process-wide rule. Rodinal times from current recipes.json; source classified as community (Massive Dev Chart) since no authority is recorded in the current data. HP5 EI 400 row = current data; EI 800 row = illustrative per plan example §2.6b. Pre-wet dropped (Q9).
